name: Model Risk Management
description: Model inventory, validation status, findings, performance monitoring, and overrides.

metrics.name: model_count
metrics.description: Models in inventory at a point in time

metrics.name: overdue_validations
metrics.description: Models past their validation due date

metrics.name: open_findings
metrics.description: Open validation findings at a point in time

metrics.name: override_rate
metrics.description: Overridden model outputs divided by total outputs

conventions.rule: Report findings and overdue counts by tier; high-tier models carry more weight.
Model counts depend on the inventory definition (model vs. tool vs. EUC); state it.

caveats.text: Inventory data reflects governance records, which can lag actual model use.

chart_conventions.rule: Show findings as an aging table by severity and tier.

review.notes: Drafted from public, general industry conventions; not yet reviewed by a named domain owner.
